question: Among drivers born after 1980, who achieved the fastest lap speed in the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix? Provide their full name and the total number of drivers who finished that race.

prediction.sql:
WITH race_results AS (
    SELECT
        res.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        res.XCL_089 AS fastest_lap_speed
    FROM results AS res
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
      AND r.XCL_066 = 2009
),
total_finished AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver_id) AS total_count
    FROM race_results
),
fastest_driver AS (
    SELECT
        d.XCL_038 AS forename,
        d.XCL_039 AS surname,
        rr.fastest_lap_speed
    FROM race_results AS rr
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON rr.driver_id = d.XCL_034
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(d.XCL_040, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1980
    ORDER BY rr.fastest_lap_speed DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    fd.forename || ' ' || fd.surname AS full_name,
    tf.total_count
FROM fastest_driver AS fd
CROSS JOIN total_finished AS tf;
